An empty body

(source_file)

================================================================================
A block with no statements
================================================================================

BEGIN
END

---

(source_file
  (block))

================================================================================
A block with a semicolon after END
================================================================================

BEGIN
  NULL;
END;

---

(source_file
  (block
    (null_statement)))

================================================================================
A block with a label
================================================================================

<<outer>>
BEGIN
  NULL;
END outer;

---

(source_file
  (block
    (label
      (identifier))
    (null_statement)
    (identifier)))

================================================================================
A nested block
================================================================================

<<outerblock>>
DECLARE
  quantity integer := 30;
BEGIN
  DECLARE
    quantity integer := 80;
  BEGIN
    RAISE NOTICE 'Inner quantity here is %', quantity;
    RAISE NOTICE 'Outer quantity here is %', outerblock.quantity;
  END;
  RETURN quantity;
END;

---

(source_file
  (block
    (label
      (identifier))
    (declare_section
      (variable_declaration
        (identifier)
        (type
          (identifier))
        (sql_expression)))
    (block
      (declare_section
        (variable_declaration
          (identifier)
          (type
            (identifier))
          (sql_expression)))
      (raise_statement
        (string)
        (sql_expression))
      (raise_statement
        (string)
        (sql_expression)))
    (return_statement
      (sql_expression))))

  arow RECORD;

================================================================================
Declarations with defaults, CONSTANT, NOT NULL and COLLATE
================================================================================

DECLARE
  quantity integer DEFAULT 32;
  url varchar := 'http://mysite.com';
  transaction_time CONSTANT timestamp with time zone := now();
  total numeric(10, 2) NOT NULL = 0;
  local_a text COLLATE "en_US";
DECLARE
  ints integer[3];
  d double precision;
BEGIN
END

================================================================================
Declarations of aliases
================================================================================

DECLARE
  subtotal ALIAS FOR $1;
  prior ALIAS FOR old;
BEGIN
  RETURN subtotal * 0.06;
END

================================================================================
Declarations of cursors
================================================================================

DECLARE
  curs1 refcursor;
  curs2 CURSOR FOR SELECT * FROM tenk1;
  curs3 CURSOR (key integer) FOR SELECT * FROM tenk1 WHERE unique1 = key;
  curs4 NO SCROLL CURSOR IS SELECT 1;
  curs5 SCROLL CURSOR (a int, b text) FOR SELECT a, b;
BEGIN
END

---

          (type
            (identifier)))
        (sql_statement))

================================================================================
Handlers of exceptions
================================================================================

BEGIN
  UPDATE mytab SET firstname = 'Joe' WHERE lastname = 'Jones';
  x := x + 1;
  y := x / 0;
EXCEPTION
  WHEN division_by_zero THEN
    RAISE NOTICE 'caught division_by_zero';
    RETURN x;
  WHEN unique_violation OR SQLSTATE '22012' THEN
    NULL;
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    RAISE;
END;

---

(source_file
  (block
    (sql_command
      (sql_statement))
    (assignment
      (variable
        (identifier))
      (sql_expression))
    (assignment
      (variable
        (identifier))
      (sql_expression))
    (exception_section
      (exception_handler
        (identifier)
        (raise_statement
          (string))
        (return_statement
          (sql_expression)))
      (exception_handler
        (identifier)
        (sqlstate
          (string))
        (null_statement))
      (exception_handler
        (identifier)
        (raise_statement)))))

================================================================================
Comments
================================================================================

-- a line comment
BEGIN
  /* a block /* nested */ comment */
  x := 1; -- after a statement
  y := 2 /* inside */ + 3;
END
